descripcion: A flaw was found in the keycloak-services component of Keycloak, which is used for managing authentication and authorization flows. The issue occurs when a client policy is configured to enforce a high-assurance authentication flow requiring OTP. Due to improper validation of existing sessions, a lower-assurance password-only SSO session can be incorrectly accepted if the request does not explicitly demand a specific assurance level. This allows an attacker with access to a user's password or session to bypass the second factor and obtain tokens claiming a higher level of security. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:3.1 CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) 6.80 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) MEDIUM

An unencrypted RSA private key for a default HTTPS certificate is included in GeoVision GV-EBD4700 firmware V1.11 (A02-GV-EBD4700_V1.11_2026_10_13.zip) at /program/www/ssl_cert.pem and copied to /config/ssl_cert.pem during initialization. When HTTPS is enabled using the default certificate, a network on-path attacker who obtains the firmware image can use the exposed private key to present an identical certificate and intercept HTTPS traffic. HTTPS is disabled by default . * Only impacts deployments where an administrator enables HTTPS and retains the default certificate. Because the private key is publicly distributed in the firmware image, an on-path attacker can impersonate the device with an identical certificate fingerprint, bypassing fingerprint checks and stored certificate exceptions (potentially capturing credentials if a user clicks through the expired-certificate warning). 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Vector CVSS:4.0 CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:H/AT:P/PR:N/UI:P/VC:N/VI:N/VA:N/SC:H/SI:N/SA:N/E:X/CR:X/IR:X/AR:X/MAV:X/MAC:X/MAT:X/MPR:X/MUI:X/MVC:X/MVI:X/MVA:X/MSC:X/MSI:X/MSA:X/S:X/AU:X/R:X/V:X/RE:X/U:X Gravedad 4.0 4.90 Gravedad 4.0 txt MEDIUM Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

Strong::Random versions through 0.96 for Perl allow every later rand output to be predicted from three earlier ones. The generator keeps its state in a single number. Each call multiplies the state by a factor derived from it, and the returned digits encode that factor, so three consecutive outputs determine the state however the generator was seeded. Outputs are also biased: the first digit after the decimal point is never zero, so rand(256) never returns 1 to 24. An attacker who sees three consecutive outputs can predict the tokens, passwords or key bytes that the same object later issues to other users. 25/11/2026 25/11/2026 Gravedad 3.1 Txt Gravedad 3.1 (CVSS 3.1 Base Score) Pendiente de análisis

AutoGPT is a workflow automation platform for creating, deploying, and managing continuous artificial intelligence agents. Prior to 0.10.0, the format Jinja filter in TextFormatter accepts an unbounded width. An authenticated user who can author or run a workflow, or supply its input, can trigger a single synchronous multi-gigabyte allocation that exhausts the executor worker's memory and degrades or denies execution for other users. There is no confidentiality or integrity impact.
